emma.name: Emma Carter
emma.intro: Thank you for joining us today. I'm Emma Carter, the hiring manager, and I'll be leading this interview.

olivia.name: Olivia Bennett
olivia.intro: Hello, I'm Olivia Bennett, from Human Resources. It's nice to meet you.

liam.name: Liam Walker
liam.intro: Hi there, I'm Liam Walker. I lead the team you would be working with.

james.name: James Whitfield
james.intro: Good to meet you. I'm James Whitfield, the department director.

questions.text: Can you tell me a little about yourself?
Where do you see yourself in 3–5 years from now?
questions.spoken: Where do you see yourself in three to five years from now?

questions.text: Let’s talk about salary. What are you looking for?
What is the biggest mistake you have ever made?
Tell me about a problem you have solved.
What has been your greatest achievement?
Would you rather work for money or job satisfaction?
How are you when you are working under pressure?
How would your boss, supervisors, or co-workers describe you?
What sort of people do you not like to work with?
